strings.name: Kristalina Georgieva
strings.summary: Born in Sofia, Georgieva trained in economics, taught, worked on World Bank environment and development, and managed EU aid and budgets. Leading the IMF from 2019, she addressed pandemic finance, debt and financial stability. In the 2021 World Bank data controversy she denied misconduct; the IMF board reaffirmed confidence after review. She began a second term in 2024.
